headline: The registry namespace lever was reported yesterday as needing a human. It did not. It is claimed, measured and live.

namespace.how: served /.well-known/mcp-registry-auth from a git-connected Cloudflare Pages site, no DNS token, no human step
namespace.scope_correction: registry SEARCH only. No client picker inherits the ASCII sort: VS Code, Goose, Dify, Smithery and Windsurf each re-rank by their own rule.
namespace.rolled_out: one server, deliberately. Publishing the fleet under an AI-tools-review brand is a branding decision, not a technical one.

distribution.awesome_mcp_servers: PR 13473 was closed for adding multiple servers. Four single-server PRs opened; 13963 is the first fully green entry this project has ever put in front of that maintainer, with a live Glama badge.
distribution.goose: three PRs open on block/goose, one server each, every endpoint tested as a stranger first
distribution.vscode_gallery: registry-backed and syncs from the official registry, 250 rows, none ours. No submission path exists; it is a ranked cut and now a watched surface.

inbound_links.verified: all four independently re-fetched and confirmed
inbound_links.premise_was_stale: the brief said 2 sites linked; 12 did
inbound_links.regression_found: 2 of those 12 vanished within 48 hours because they were written into build output rather than repo source

storefront.privacy_page: added, with real retention figures and a contact route that exists

damage_found_elsewhere.what: wrongful-death-settlement-calculator and settlement-formula both 404, and sitemap.xml 404s
damage_found_elsewhere.cause: published to live but never committed; a later repo deploy rebuilt without them
damage_found_elsewhere.recoverable: no. Not in the repo, no local copy, no Wayback snapshot.
